integrity: The all-positive/all-negative trace conditions, n=2 boundary, last-pair exception, and all-degree counting are proved directly; classical pairing counts are credited; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: All n >= 2 for complete graphs with exactly one prescribed perfect matching deleted; no result on arbitrary forbidden boards, homotopy groups, or exhaustive historical priority; finite verification corroborates, but is not the proof.
title: Complete Boolean shattering of deranged pairings: a pure complex with an exact top-face correction
